svg.title: Second Iradi Civil War, 2007
svg.desc: The situation in late May 2007, the Storming of Talas on 4 June, the DPI takeover of the cities over the summer and the September 2007 ceasefire line. The line is shown as it ran before the 2009 protocol, approximately: the Toktogul basin and the State Route 1 corridor were then tribal land, and the high Kyrgyz Range east of the Kök-Bel road was in the ISEZ. Base map: Natural Earth (public domain); routes and present-day zones from the Kartalar map data.
